name: Kisaragi Yuma
source:
Yuma has the duty of keeping her older sister [url=/c20388]Nayu[/url] in line. She is the only one who is able to stop Nayu once she starts rampaging.

Due to her previously extremely carefree disposition, she's rather ignorant about most household chores; However, laundry in particular is one thing she takes pride in.

[spoiler][url=/c48508]Nayu[/url] brought her back to life with the Necronomicon before the events of ~unreality~ take place.[/spoiler]
